                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For an equilateral triangle, the relationship between Area and side (a) is: Area = (√3/4) × a2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given Area = 16√3, we have 16√3 = (√3/4) × a2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Eliminate √3 from both sides: 16 = a2/4 ⇒ a2 = 64.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Taking square root: a = 8 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Area of equilateral triangle = 16√3 cm2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Area = (√3/4) × (side)2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 16√3 = (√3/4) × a2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 16 = a2 / 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a2 = 16 × 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a2 = 64

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a = √64

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a = 8 cm

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Height of Equilateral Triangle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The altitude or height (h) of an equilateral triangle is given by h = (√3/2) × a.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Perimeter of Equilateral Triangle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Since all three sides are equal, the perimeter (P) = 3 × a.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Inradius and Circumradius

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3. Note that R = 2r.दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (√3/4) x a2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        जहाँ, a = भुजा की लंबाई

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (√3/4) x a2 = 16√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a2 = (16√3 x 4)/√3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ a2 = 16 x 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

Both numbers must be composite (not prime). 2. Their HCF must be 1 (co-prime).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Option 1: (21, 35) → Both composite, but HCF = 7.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Option 2: (19, 27) → 19 is a prime number.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Option 3: (11, 17) → Both are prime numbers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Option 4: (8, 25) → Both are composite and HCF = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is (8, 25).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given: Pairs of numbers to check for non-prime and co-prime status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Definitions: Prime Number has exactly 2 factors. Co-prime numbers have an HCF of 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Case 1: (21, 35) → Factors of 21: 1, 3, 7, 21; Factors of 35: 1, 5, 7, 35. HCF = 7 (Not co-prime).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Case 2: (19, 27) → 19 is a Prime Number (Violates first condition).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Case 3: (11, 17) → Both 11 and 17 are Prime Numbers (Violates first condition).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Case 4: (8, 25) → Factors of 8: 1, 2, 4, 8; Factors of 25: 1, 5, 25. Both are Composite and HCF = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is (8, 25).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Co-prime Numbers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) or HCF is 1. They do not need to be prime numbers themselves.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Composite Numbers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Numbers that have more than two factors are composite. 1 is neither prime nor composite.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Twin Primes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A pair of prime numbers that have a difference of 2, such as (11, 13) or (17, 19).प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        यदि दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक (GCD) 1 है, तो वे सहअभाज्य होती हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1) युग्म (21, 35)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        21 = 3 x 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        35 = 5 x 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        GCD (21, 35) = 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दोनों संख्याएँ सहअभाज्य नहीं हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2) युग्म (19, 27)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गलत।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3) युग्म (11, 17)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11 और 17 दोनों अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        రెండు సంఖ్యలు సహ-ప్రధానమైనవి కావు.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2) జత (19, 27)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        తప్పు.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3) జత (11, 17)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11 మరియు 17 రెండూ ప్రధాన సంఖ్యలు.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        4) జత (8, 25)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1) জোড়া (21, 35)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ভুল।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3) জোড়া (11, 17)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11 এবং 17 উভয়ই মৌলিক সংখ্যা।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ভুল।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        4) জোড়া (8, 25)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ સાચો જવાબ વિકલ્પ 4 છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಸೂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಮಹತ್ತಮ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಪವರ್ತನ (GCD) 1 ಆಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಅವು ಸಹ-ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯಗಳಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        21 = 3 x 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        35 = 5 x 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        GCD(21, 35) = 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಎರಡೂ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ಸಹ-ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2) ಜೋಡಿ (19, 27)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
