                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Median = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mean = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The empirical relationship for a moderately skewed distribution is:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mode = 3(Median) − 2(Mean)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Mode = (3 × 30) − (2 × 25)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Mode = 90 − 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Mode = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is 40.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Symmetrical Distribution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In a perfectly symmetrical distribution, the Mean, Median, and Mode are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Skewed Distribution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For positively skewed data, Mean > Median > Mode. For negatively skewed data, Mean < Median < Mode.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternative Formula Form

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The relation can also be written as: (Mean − Mode) = 3(Mean − Median).दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                माध्य = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                माध्यिका = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                बहुलक = 3 × माध्यिका - 2 × माध्य

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                बहुलक = 3 × 30 - 2 × 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ बहुलक = 90 - 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ बहुलक = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प (4) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                సగటు = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                మధ్యగతం = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                బాహుళకం = 3 x మధ్యగతం - 2 x సగటు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                బాహుళకం = 3 x 30 - 2 x 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ బాహుళకం = 90 - 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ బాహుళకం = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ సరైన సమాధానం ఎంపిక (4).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                मध्य = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                मध्यक = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                बहुलक = 3 x मध्यक - 2 x मध्य

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                बहुलक = 3 x 30 - 2 x 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ बहुलक = 90 - 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ बहुलक = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ योग्य उत्तर पर्याय (4) आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                গড় = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                মধ্যমা = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                সংখ্যাগুরু মানে = 3 x মধ্যমা - 2 x গড়

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                সংখ্যাগুরু মান = 3 x 30 - 2 x 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ সংখ্যাগুরু মান = 90 - 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ প্রচুরক = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ সঠিক উত্তরটি হল (4) নম্বর বিকল্প।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                મધ્યક = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                મધ્યસ્થ = 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલો સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                બહુલક = 3 x મધ્યસ્થ - 2 x મધ્યક

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
