                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ஆவியாதல்: திரவம் வாயுவாக மாறும் செயல்முறை, கொதித்தல் மற்றும் ஆவியாதல் ஆகியவை அடங்கும்.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • பதங்கமாதல்: திடப்பொருள் நேரடியாக திரவமாக மாறாமல் வாயுவாக மாறும் செயல்முறை.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n252:Tb44,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Difference in quantity = (2 tables + 3 chairs) − (2 tables + 1 chair) = 2 chairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Difference in cost = ₹540 − ₹470 = ₹70.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 2 chairs = ₹70 ⇒ Cost of 1 chair = ₹35.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 35 chairs = 35 × 35 = ₹1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Difference in quantity = (2 tables + 3 chairs) − (2 tables + 1 chair) = 2 chairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Difference in cost = ₹540 − ₹470 = ₹70.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 2 chairs = ₹70 ⇒ Cost of 1 chair = ₹35.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 35 chairs = 35 × 35 = ₹1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 2 Tables + 3 Chairs = ₹540 --- (i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost of 2 Tables + 1 Chair = ₹470 --- (ii)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Subtracting equation (ii) from equation (i):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (2T + 3C) − (2T + 1C) = 540 − 470

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 2C = 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ C = 70 ÷ 2 = ₹35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Cost of 35 chairs = 35 × C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Cost of 35 chairs = 35 × 35 = ₹1225

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Linear Equations in Two Variables

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            These problems follow the form ax + by = c. When one variable's coefficient is the same in both equations, subtraction eliminates it directly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Unitary Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            First find the value of a single unit (1 chair) and then multiply by the required quantity (35 chairs) to find the total cost.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Squares Shortcut

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            For numbers ending in 5, the square is calculated as: (n × (n+1)) followed by 25. For 352: (3 × 4) = 12, so 1225.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n253:Tacc,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2 मेजों और 3 कुर्सियों का मूल्य ₹540 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2 मेजों और 1 कुर्सी का मूल्य ₹470 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            माना एक मेज का मूल्य T और एक कुर्सी का मूल्य C है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2T + 3C = 540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2T + 1C = 470

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दूसरे समीकरण को पहले समीकरण से घटाने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (2T + 3C) - (2T + 1C) = 540 - 470

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 2C = 70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ C = 35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            अब, 35 कुर्सियों का मूल्य:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 35 x 35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ ₹1225

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प (3) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2 టేబుల్స్ మరియు 3 కుర్చీల ధర ₹540.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2 టేబుల్స్ మరియు 1 కుర్చీ ధర ₹470.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఒక టేబుల్ ధర T మరియు ఒక కుర్చీ ధర C అనుకుందాం.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2T + 3C = 540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2T + 1C = 470

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            మొదటి సమీకరణం నుండి రెండవ సమీకరణాన్ని తీసివేయండి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
